name: Improved [Insert Combat Maneuver] (Combat)
body:
You are skilled at performing a specific combat maneuver.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Combat Expertise.

Benefit(s): You do not provoke an attack of opportunity when performing a [Insert Combat Maneuver] combat maneuver. In addition, you receive a +2 bonus to your Combat Maneuver Bonus when performing this combat maneuver against a foe. You also receive a +2 bonus to your Combat Maneuver Defense whenever an opponent tries to perform this combat maneuver against you.

Normal: You provoke an attack of opportunity when performing a [Insert Combat maneuver] combat maneuver.
